rail.note: Your draft stays on your SimpleFit account.

interests.title: Partnership interests
interests.lead: What would you like to do with the boxing community?

goals.title: Goals
goals.lead: Tell us about your brand and what you hope to do.

uploads.title: Uploads
uploads.lead: Optional. You can apply without files.

review.title: Review and submit
review.lead: Check your answers. SimpleFit reviews every application.

changes.title: SimpleFit asked for changes:
changes.rest: Your other answers stay as they are.
changes.locked: Only the answers SimpleFit asked about can change now.

required.contact_email: Enter an email address like name@company.com.

errors.invalidFormat: Check the format of this answer.
errors.notRequested: SimpleFit didn’t ask to change this answer.
errors.invalidEmail: Enter an email address like name@company.com.
errors.invalidPhone: Enter the number in international format, like +48221234567.
errors.invalidWebsite: Enter an address that starts with https://.

fields.workEmailHelp: We use this to discuss your application. It doesn’t change how you sign in.
fields.contactPrivacy: We only use these details to discuss your application. They’re never shown to athletes or gyms.
fields.interestsHelp: This tells us what interests you. It doesn’t reserve or promise anything.
fields.sponsoredLabel: Anything sponsored in the future would be labelled “Sponsored” and kept out of workouts, private messages and payments.
fields.budgetNoteTitle: This is an estimate, not a commitment.
fields.budgetNote: It isn’t a price, an invoice, a purchase or an agreement. It helps us understand scale, and it’s never shown publicly.
fields.goalsPlaceholder: What would you like to do with the boxing community?

problems.check: {count, plural, one {# answer to check} other {# answers to check}}

saveFailed.title: We couldn’t save your last change.
saveFailed.body: Stay on this page and try again. Your earlier answers are safe.

submitFailed.title: We couldn’t submit your application.
submitFailed.body: Nothing was sent, and your answers are still here. Try again.

stale.title: This draft changed somewhere else.
stale.body: Reload to see the latest version. Your unsaved answers stay here.

moved.title: This application can’t be changed now.
moved.body: Its status changed. Your answers weren’t saved.

declaration.title: The declaration changed.
declaration.body: Read it again and confirm it before you submit.

account.title: Your account isn’t finished.
account.body: Add your name, date of birth and consents first. You’ll come back here.

rateLimited.title: Too many attempts.
rateLimited.body: Wait a few minutes, then try again.

conflict.title: That didn’t work.
conflict.body: Nothing changed. Reload the page and try again.

review.nothingSaved: You haven’t saved any answers yet.
review.declarationFailed: We couldn’t load the declaration, so you can’t submit yet.
review.closedBody: Your draft is saved, and you can keep editing it.
review.whatSubmitBody: it sends your answers to SimpleFit for review. It doesn’t create a Sponsor workspace, a partnership, a payment or an agreement.

unavailable.title: Uploads aren’t available yet.
unavailable.body: Files need a safety scan, which SimpleFit doesn’t have today. You can apply without files.
unavailable.note: PDF, PNG or JPEG. Only the SimpleFit team could see them.

uploads.dropTitle: Add a brand deck or brief
uploads.rules: {types}, up to {size} each, {count} files at most.
uploads.needsDraft: Save an answer first: files attach to a saved application.
uploads.privacy: Only the SimpleFit team can see your documents.

problems.size: Choose a file of {size} or less.
problems.name: Rename the file to 120 characters or fewer, then try again.
problems.limit: You can add {count} files at most. Remove one first.
problems.storage: The file didn’t upload. Check your connection and try again.
problems.mismatch: The uploaded file didn’t match what was expected, so it was removed. Try again.
problems.unavailable: File storage isn’t available right now. Try again in a few minutes.
problems.unconfirmed: We couldn’t confirm the upload. Try again.
problems.stale: Your application changed somewhere else. We’ve reloaded it: try again.
problems.session: You’ve been signed out. Sign in again to upload.
problems.rateLimited: Too many uploads. Wait a few minutes, then try again.

signed_out.title: Sign in to start your application
signed_out.body: Use your SimpleFit account, or create one. Your draft is saved to the account, so you can come back from any device.

registration.title: First, finish your account
registration.body: Your SimpleFit account needs your name, date of birth and consents. You’ll come straight back to your application afterwards.

ready.title: You’re ready to start
ready.body: You’re signed in. Answers save to this account as you go.

resume.title: Continue your application?
resume.body: You have a draft on this account. Pick up where you left off.

exists.title: You’ve already applied
exists.body: You can see where your application stands, or change it if we’ve asked you to.

member.title: You’re already a partner
member.body: You belong to a Sponsor organization on this account.

expired.title: You’ve been signed out
expired.body: Sign in again to continue. Your last saved version is safe.

error.title: We couldn’t check your account
error.body: Nothing changed. Check your connection and try again.

how.title: How this works

application.label: Your application
application.value: Saved as a draft until you submit

how.note: Choosing Sponsor gives your account no extra access. Only an approved application creates a workspace, and it isn’t a contract.

entry.signInNote: New to SimpleFit? You can create an account from the email sign-in. Signing in doesn’t create a Sponsor workspace.

submitted.title: Application received
submitted.body: Thank you for your interest in SimpleFit Boxing. A person on our team reviews every application.
submitted.note: This doesn’t create a Sponsor workspace, a partnership or an agreement.

draft.title: Your draft isn’t submitted
draft.body: Only you can see it. Nobody at SimpleFit has reviewed anything yet.

submitted.title: We’ve received your application
submitted.body: It’s waiting for someone at SimpleFit to review it.

under_review.title: We’re reviewing your application
under_review.body: A person at SimpleFit is looking at it. You can’t edit it during review.

changes_requested.title: We need a few changes
changes_requested.body: Update your answers and send them back. The rest of your application stays as it is.

approved.title: Your application is approved
approved.note: Approval lets you use the workspace. It isn’t a contract, a campaign or a commitment by either side.

rejected.title: We can’t go ahead with this application
rejected.body: This decision applies to this application.

unknown.title: We can’t show this status here yet
unknown.body: Your application is safe. Check back later.
